videos.titulo: QR Code Squares: What the 3 Corners Actually Do
videos.descripcion:
The three big squares on a QR code are finder patterns. They tell the camera where the code is, how big it is and which way is up, so it scans at any angle. QR codes were created in 1994 to track car parts.

Sources: Britannica, QR code (britannica.com) · Keyence, What is a QR code? (keyence.com).
